notes: Session WebSearch budget (200/200) was already exhausted before this run, so vimeo, conference-archive, SlideShare, app-store and court-exhibit sweeps could not be performed; vimeo search returned 403 to direct fetch. Fourteen ytsearch queries and six channel listings ran. Upload dates, durations and view counts for kept YouTube items could not be batch-fetched (extractor error on all nine URLs after two attempts); flat-playlist listings return NA for duration/views on channel pages. Findings: no network (STAR, Accel, NYCE, SHAZAM, CULIANCE, Jeanie, AFFN) has a public recorded demo of its participant portal, sandbox, onboarding or certification flow. SHAZAM gates all tool training inside SHAZAM Access; its content library and events pages render client-side and returned no items. FIS routes NYCE and CULIANCE participants to the generic FIS Client Portal. jeanie.com is parked (certificate points at a domain-parking host). developer.fiserv.com returned an empty body. The @SHAZAMnetwork and @Velera handles given in the brief are wrong or empty; SHAZAM's real channel is titled 'SHAZAM'. Recommend a follow-up run with WebSearch available for: 'SHAZAM Forum' replays, ATMIA/US Payments Forum decks on STAR/NYCE routing, and any bank-republished SHAZAM Access quick-reference PDFs. yt-dlp/search calls used: 25 plus one retry of a shell-failed call; page reads: 14.
